title: It was much easier to do...
text: It was much easier to do than I expected, even on the sea.  We had a lot of fun and got to see an amazing sunrise.
author: Court_S

title: Great experience!
text:
Watching the sun rise from the sea was absolutely stunning… something I’ll never forget. Definitely worth waking up early for! Seeing the sunrise from the water, at water level, gives you such a different perspective from the usual view from the beach or a boat.

The team leading us was great. They made sure we all felt safe and kept a close eye on everyone throughout the experience, which really impressed me.

I absolutely recommend it!
author: DanieleFleur

title: Best Morning Ever
text: Honestly was second guessing on going because of the early wake up call, but it was absolutely worth it and might be one of my favorite take aways from this trip. The instructors were amazing and it was so relaxing and beautiful.
